mike: Anyone know the best dashboard for GPU throughput / SM% / KV cache hit? Trying to tune batch_size for seq=2048 workloads and want the panels + recommended queries. Also where are the alerts for GPU saturation? :eyes:
sasha: There's a few places — start with the GPU → Throughput dashboard in Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/xyz/gpu-throughput. Key panels: 'SM Utilization (per GPU)', 'GPU Memory (per model)', 'KV cache hit rate', and 'Tokens/sec by batch size'.
jamal: Can you paste the PromQL / grafana query for 95th pct SM util? Want to add to the perf runbook.
sasha: Sure — our common 95pql is:
```
avg_over_time((sum by (gpu) (rate(nvidia_gpu_sm_active_cycles_total[1m])) / sum by (gpu) (nvidia_gpu_total_cycles)) * 100[5m])
```
Use that in a dashboard stat panel set to 95th. For grafana panel it's usually an alias like `gpu_sm_95p_5m`.
elaine: Heads up — current alert `GPU_SM_HIGH` is firing a lot. It uses `avg_over_time(gpu_sm_95p[5m]) > 88` and noise from short spikes triggers P0. Propose: change to `gpu_sm_95p` > 92 for 10m and keep page only for >95 for 5m. Otherwise set to severity=warning.
jamal: Agree we should backfill before changing. Can the observability infra run a 7d backfill query for the new threshold and report false positives?
observability-bot: Scheduled: `gpu-sm-95th-backfill` for 7d starting now. Results will be posted to this thread when complete (approx 30m). :gear:
sasha: For KV cache: panel query we use is:
```
(sum by (model) (kv_cache_hits_total) / sum by (model) (kv_cache_lookups_total))
```
Show it as a percentage and then a small timeseries with a 1h avg. If hit < 0.7 on heavy seq models, consider increasing prefix cache TTL or pinning hot prefixes.
mike: OK I'll run a canary: batch_size 32 -> 48 on the canary pool for seq=2048. Will monitor tokens/sec, tail latency, and kv-hit. Ping me if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment started for canary `gpu-pool-canary` with env `BATCH_SIZE=48`. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/35879 (streaming).
elaine: If canary looks stable, schedule a gradual rollout and update the runbook with the new alert thresholds and the backfill results. Also add a short note in the 'gpu-tuning' doc about the batch-size vs kv-hit tradeoff.
mike: Thanks all — I'll post canary metrics snapshot in ~15m.
observability-bot: Backfill `gpu-sm-95th-backfill` completed. Summary: 7d window, 3% of 5m windows >92% (mostly during loadtests), 0.4% >95% (prod). Posting full CSV to: https://storage.redwood.com/observability/backfills/gpu-sm-95th-1752489000.csv
jamal: Nice, that supports raising warning to 92 and paging at 95. I'll draft the alert change and open a PR.
sasha: Thanks — LMK the PR and I'll review quickly. Also adding a dashboard link to the runbook now: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/xyz/gpu-throughput
mike: Perfect. :slightly_smiling_face:
